content: Course: EE C222 | EECS at UC Berkeley EE C222. Nonlinear Systems Catalog Description: Basic graduate course in nonlinear systems. Nonlinear phenomena, planar systems, bifurcations, center manifolds, existence and uniqueness theorems. Lyapunovâs direct and indirect methods, Lyapunov-based feedback stabilization.
